We began by investigating the currently available Substrate templates, and we decided on using the minimal template. The repository starting point is the minimal template, and we will build on top of this. We also included important documentation such as installation and running instructions, contribution and release procedure guidelines. We also added a CI action to verify the code on pull requests.

ms.promise:
1) Initial Substrate node customizations: A Substrate client that will include the required high-level customizations. This changes will include the selection of a consensus mechanism, a ledger model and storage structure. This client won't perform any real functions but will be able to bootstrap and connect to peers, serving as a robust foundation for further development.
2) Dev activity log: A detailed log of the development activities that were required for the Substrate client customization. This log will serve as guidance for new developers wishing to understand the process with the goal of implementing their own versions.
